title: Kenworth K104,K108,K200 FUPS Compliant Custom Built Polshed Alumium Bullbar #92
description: Kenworth K104, KJ108, K200 FUPS compliant high tensile aluminium Bullbar. Contoured outer uprights with bracing. One piece 76mm lower cross tube through drilled uprights and recessed into drilled outer uprights. Driving light mount to suit application, extra depth main channel with high tensile aluminium backing plate with 38mm tow pin. Front mudflap mounts are standard. Bull bar can be custom built to your specifications.
